cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 66 (Baldwin and Escambia counties) since 2006. Former teacher and coach at T.R. Miller High School in Brewton. Works as director of a mortgage and refinance business. Auburn University graduate (1978).
cands.gaps: We couldn't find where Baker was born or raised, or when he came to Alabama. The pages we had list no bills he sponsored and no specific actions on the issues in this guide. We found no stated positions from him on data centers, development, property taxes, immigration, guns, abortion, schools or policing. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026, and Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for him in 2026. We found no documented controversies or foreign ties.

qual.background: Has served in the Alabama House since 2006 (20 years). Earlier he was a teacher and coach at T.R. Miller High School, and he is director of a mortgage and refinance business.
qual.why: Two decades of legislative service puts him in the high band, and his mortgage business work adds finance experience. Committee posts were not counted.
